Maya Chen: Heads-up — I just realized we have a coverage gap for the upcoming long weekend (US federal holiday). Primary is scheduled to roll off Friday 23:59 UTC and the next assigned engineer is out until Monday morning. Need a last-minute volunteer to cover primary for Sat-Sun (00:00-23:59 UTC) or split shifts. This is the thread for quick handoff + runbook pointers.

oncall-bot: Reminder: upcoming holiday schedule detected. Please confirm handoff by replying in thread.

Alex Nguyen: Ugh, I missed that in the rota. I can take Sat 00:00-12:00 UTC (primary) if someone can do Sat 12:00-23:59 + Sun full day.

Sam Ortiz: I can do Sun 00:00-12:00 UTC, but I have a wedding to be at on Sun afternoon otherwise I'd take the full day.

Priya Kapoor: I can pick up Sat 12:00-23:59 and Sun 12:00-23:59 — but prefer to be secondary for first hour after handoff if Alex can't answer quick questions.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. That covers most pieces. Can we lock it as: Alex primary Sat 00-12, Priya primary Sat 12-23:59 & Sun 12-23:59, Sam primary Sun 00-12 and secondary otherwise? Also need a secondary for Sat 00-12 — Lee?

Lee Park: I can be secondary Sat 00-12 (happy to take pages). Will add notes to the rota.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Two quick operational notes (from last month’s incident): the main page source for client-facing latency is the inference-routes pipeline (service: inference-router). If you get paged with >3x baseline p95, follow the quick mitigation below.

Maya Chen: Runbook excerpt (paste of the short checklist):
```
1) Check infra: 
   - `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-router`
   - check GPU utilization `nvidia-smi` on the node (if you have direct access) or use Console -> Nodes -> metrics
2) If router pods OOM or `CrashLoopBackOff` -> restart set with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-router -n inference`
3) If tokenization errors / malformed requests -> look at `logs:/services/inference-router/*` for 400s and identify client id
4) Fallback: switch routing policy to model-variant `llama-13b-quant` (lower mem) if primary model hitting OOMs; use Console -> Routes -> override -> variant
5) If paging spike persists >15min -> escalate to SRE lead and open incident channel (#incidents)
```

Maya Chen: Link to full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-router-failures (bookmark this)

Alex Nguyen: Quick question — what's the fastest way to flip the routing policy from CLI?

Maya Chen: You can use `redwoodctl` (requires org-admin or oncall role):
```
redwoodctl routes override --route inference-serving-prod --variant llama-13b-quant --expires 30m
```
If you don't have `redwoodctl`, Console override works too.

Sam Ortiz: For pages, please use standard escalation: page primary first, wait 4 mins, if no acknowledge page secondary. If paging repeatedly, call the SRE pager (number in wiki).

Priya Kapoor: Adding a small note on alerts — we recently tuned the anomaly detector. The alert you will most likely see is `inference-router.high_latency` with tags `region:eastus` or `route:chat_stream`. If you see `memory_pressure` tag, that's higher severity.

Lee Park: I'll set a reminder for 30m before the handoff window to ping Alex and Priya in case we need to swap.

oncall-bot: Hand-off checklist required: `ack` from both primary and secondary in thread. Please run `/oncall acknowledge` to confirm.

Alex Nguyen: /oncall acknowledge — I'm set for Sat 00:00-12:00 UTC. Will make sure VPN and console access are tested.

Priya Kapoor: /oncall acknowledge — set for Sat 12:00-23:59 + Sun 12:00-23:59. I'll post short runbook notes into my personal docs for quick copy.

Sam Ortiz: /oncall acknowledge — Sun 00:00-12:00. If anything heavy happens after 12:00 I may be slow.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I've updated the rota and the holiday coverage doc. A couple more micro-ops tips:
- If you need to escalate to dedicated infra, ping `@infra-oncall` and copy the incident channel.
- If customers are impacted (>= 5% errors or 30+ active failing requests) mark incident severity as P2 and notify customer-success with the template.

Maya Chen: Customer-impact template (short):
```
- Impact: inference errors / latency for X% users in region Y
- Start time: <UTC time>
- Mitigation: switched routing to llama-13b-quant; restarting router replicas
- Next steps: monitor for 30m; prepare rollback plan
```

Alex Nguyen: One more: I don't have `redwoodctl` on my laptop yet — I will test Console overrides and SSH access tonight.

Maya Chen: If anyone else needs access, ping me or run the access request flow: https://redwood.internal/access-requests (oncall role).

Priya Kapoor: I'll leave a short 2-line summary note in the rota under my day so next oncall can scan quickly.

Lee Park: Good luck everyone, and please call me if it gets noisy — I can take pages. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: OK closing the thread — coverage assigned: Alex (Sat 00-12 primary), Lee (Sat 00-12 secondary), Priya (Sat 12-23:59 primary + Sun 12-23:59), Sam (Sun 00-12 primary). Everyone has acknowledged. If anything changes, reply here and I'll update the rota.

oncall-bot: Coverage updated in rota (holiday-weekend-2028).
